mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_tenant WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_tenant WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_tenant WHERE deleted = 0 AND expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT status AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system_tenant WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT COALESCE(p.name, '未分配') AS name, COUNT(t.id) AS cnt FROM system_tenant t LEFT JOIN system_tenant_package p ON t.package_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.package_id, p.name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system_tenant WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{beginTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.name AS tenantName, t.contact_name AS contactName, t.expire_time AS expireTime FROM system_tenant t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND t.expire_time BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY t.expire_time
